info.name: Supplements Store API
info.description:
Generated directly from the backend's actual registered route table (97 API routes) so it cannot silently drift out of sync — every GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE the server exposes has a request here, organized into the folders required by the backend brief section 27 (Auth, Users, Sellers, Brands, Categories, Products, Variants, Inventory, Cart, Wishlist, Bundles, Coupons, Orders, Reviews, Admin, Health), plus Banners/Uploads, plus a dedicated 'Negative & Edge Cases' folder covering the specific scenarios the brief requires: 401 without a token, 403 for the wrong role, seller ownership denial, insufficient stock, invalid coupon, successful checkout, cart clearing after checkout, and duplicate review.

Suggested run order: Health -> Auth (register/login capture tokens automatically via test scripts) -> Categories/Brands (admin, to get IDs) -> Products/Variants (seller) -> Cart -> Orders -> Reviews -> Negative & Edge Cases.
